decoded_pixel_comparison.method: PNG decoded to canonical RGBA; SHA256 includes dimensions and all pixels

cause: Authoring/probe supplied a hidden single-series name but no visible metric title or unit axis; existing renderer already supports these fields

limitations: Pictures cannot establish native chart editability, data binding or hidden workbook values.
Correct printed values plus visually consistent heights establish visible numerical fidelity; this is not an audit of invisible underlying data.
Original-resolution screen legibility does not guarantee projected readability at every room size or viewing distance.
Unrelated pages and earlier outstanding non-chart corpus issues are not approved by this review.
independent_review.method: Every PNG opened individually at original resolution; each chart on each page checked for visible labels, printed values, axis heights, units, metric identity and four visual lenses. Expected labels were compared to actual pixels, not assumed to render.
